description: This file defines an interface for building search topic paths in a protocol adapter context, focusing on different search actions such as subscribe, cancel, request, complete, etc.

classes.name: SearchTopicPathBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building topics for search actions within the protocol adapter, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Sets the action to SUBSCRIBE, replacing any previous action.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Sets the action to CANCEL, replacing any previous action.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sets the action to REQUEST, replacing any previous action.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Sets the action to COMPLETE, replacing any previous action.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Sets the action to FAILED, replacing any previous action.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Sets the action to NEXT, replacing any previous action.

methods.name: generated
methods.description: Sets the action to GENERATED, replacing any previous action.
